player_prompt.intro:
Marhaba ku Lights Out! Yïn aŋïc {size}x{size} kïïr ku tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ.
Yïn wïc ku kïïr ku tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ dɛ̈ɛ̈m aŋök (ku aŋök 'O' ku '.')
Na yïn ciɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ, ka ciɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ dɛ̈ɛ̈m ku tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ ciɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ (nhɔ̈ɔ̈m/nhɔ̈ɔ̈m/lɛ̈ɛ̈/lɛ̈ɛ̈).
Kitɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ [row col] ciɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ (0-kuat, ka kuat ku 0-{max_index}).
Yïn aŋïc ku {max_turns} kïïr ku wïc kïïr ku tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ.
Legend: 'O' = tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ dɛ̈ɛ̈m, '.' = tiɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ aŋök

board.current_state:
Tiŋ kekë thïn (Cäthke {moves_made}, {moves_left} cäthke lɛɛu, {completion}% bë kɛmɛ):

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kitɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ aŋïc ku ciɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ [row col] ka row ku col aŋïc ku kuat ku 0 ku {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɔ̈ɔ̈r aŋïc bïn riɛm ë 0 ku {max_index}. Yïn kɛ̈t [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Congratulations! Yïn acï kä cï gɔ̈ɔ̈r bɛ̈n yök në {moves_used} lɔ tueŋ.
